summary: Both .env files are now present and the bug is fixed. Backend: 4/4 pytest cases pass (health, resolve public folder + cache, invalid link, empty link) with no MONGO_URL errors. Frontend (mobile 390x844): /settings loads, monitoring section is visible with correct defaults (URL=https://falacom.com.br/tv-monitor/api/heartbeat.php, Intervalo=20s), attribution reads 'FEITO por Tiago Rodrigues 64 9 84468273' (uppercase FEITO), Atualizar agora with empty link shows 'Configure o link da pasta primeiro.', and Atualizar agora with a valid public Drive folder link successfully hit /api/drive/resolve and reported 'Sincronizado — 3 arquivo(s) na playlist'. The prior 'EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL não configurada' error is gone.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py accesses os.environ['MONGO_URL'] at import time; consider os.environ.get with a clear startup error to fail with a friendly message instead of KeyError if the env is again missing.

backend.ts URL validation (isValidHttpUrl in settings.tsx) accepts 'http://' or 'https://' strings whose hostname parses to empty on some engines — currently guarded by Boolean(parsed.hostname), OK, but consider a tighter regex too.

success_rate.frontend: 100% for tested flows (settings load, defaults, attribution, empty-link error, full drive resolve via Atualizar agora)

seed_data_creation: None — used the existing public Drive folder link 1HxrMIjxOK8oF5-mR2sOg5OxpYDt4_OD7 from the existing pytest fixture.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend .env has MONGO_URL=mongodb://localhost:27017 and DB_NAME=indoor_player. Frontend .env has EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL=<preview URL>. Regression test file: /app/backend/tests/test_drive_api.py (needs EXPO_BACKEND_URL env var when running from CLI). Mobile viewport used: 390x844. Playlist state persists in localStorage between runs — clear via app if needed.
rca_of_issue: Original bug caused by missing /app/backend/.env and /app/frontend/.env. Fix (creation of both files with MONGO_URL/DB_NAME and EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL) verified end-to-end: backend starts cleanly, /api/health returns {status: ok}, /api/drive/resolve returns 400 in Portuguese for empty/invalid links, and the Settings screen no longer surfaces 'EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL não configurada'.
